finding: All six packaged .sh files contain CRLF and fail bash -n on Linux after public re-download/extract.
rootCause: Repository has no .gitattributes EOL policy; tracked shell files were committed with CRLF. build_linux_package.py writes source bytes verbatim into the ZIP and therefore preserved CRLF.
impact: Linux v1.2.0 release archive is not safely executable as shell source on Linux. Prior contract audit was semantic/text based and did not execute bash -n against the public release archive.
prevention: Normalize shell payload bytes to LF inside build_linux_package.py before hashing/packing.
Add GitHub Actions Linux job that runs bash -n on tracked shell scripts and on extracted built archive.
Patch release v1.2.1 with both Windows and Linux assets so shared latest-updater channel remains cross-platform complete.
evidenceSource: Public GitHub v1.2.0 asset downloaded on aliemad-Labtop; bash -n failed for all six .sh files.
